representative_scale.gpu_class: One H100, A100 or A10-class NVIDIA GPU; use same physical GPU for baseline and candidate. Exact available model unknown.
representative_scale.scale_policy: Fixed supplied scale; no searches, doubling loops or smaller-workload extrapolation.

inputs.source: brief.md (supplied research brief; embedded dhfr_ensemble.py driver)

equivalence_metrics.name: mean_potential_kj_mol
equivalence_metrics.source: results/reproduce/out/run/ensemble.json: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of replicas[*].mean_potential_kj_mol across seeds 1000..1007 is 123.19454760158096 kJ/mol; divide by sqrt(8) to obtain baseline Monte Carlo standard error 43.55585000714341 kJ/mol. Seal adopts one measured baseline standard error as positive absolute equivalence margin. This is cross-seed sampling variability, not measured same-seed repeatability or an independently established physical acceptance threshold.

paired_seed_tests.decision: Require the exact two-sided binomial order-statistic confidence interval for the median paired difference to lie strictly inside [-abs_margin,+abs_margin] for both metrics. Bonferroni across the two metrics; no acceptance from lack of significance.
paired_seed_tests.description: For each metric and budget, compare method minus baseline outputs matched by input identity and seed. Use one prespecified scientific observation per seed, from timing pair 0; later timing repetitions are not independent scientific seeds. All timing pairs must complete the same work. Fixed seeds do not make Langevin sampling deterministic.
paired_seed_tests.scope: Equivalence concerns typical paired energy-summary differences; it does not certify identical trajectories or every individual replica. Full energy series are not serialized and are not claimed equivalent.
